name: Bizness
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to _feeHandler, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward reentrancy exploit triggered during splitLock via the receive() fallback, followed by withdrawing the original lock before state is safely updated. The PoC is short, uses only a couple of protocol calls, and requires minimal DeFi-specific knowledge beyond recognizing the vulnerable external call ordering.
